examples.zh: 委员会在拨款前评估了提案的战略契合度。
examples.en: The committee assessed the proposal's strategic fit before funding it.

examples.zh: 这项收购与我们的服务业务战略契合度不高。
examples.en: The acquisition has little strategic fit with our service business.

examples.zh: 财务核查假设后，发起人批准了商业论证。
examples.en: The sponsor approved the business case after finance checked the assumptions.

examples.zh: 商业论证包含维护成本和预期节省额。
examples.en: The business case includes maintenance costs and expected savings.

examples.zh: 我们将在上线后六个月内追踪收益实现情况。
examples.en: We will track benefits realization for six months after launch.

examples.zh: 收益实现取决于员工真正使用新流程。
examples.en: Benefits realization depends on staff actually using the new process.

examples.zh: 新的维护项目改善了项目组合的平衡。
examples.en: The new maintenance project improves the portfolio balance.

examples.zh: 项目组合平衡需要一些回收期较短的项目。
examples.en: Portfolio balance requires some projects with shorter payback periods.

examples.zh: 发起人在详细规划前签发了项目章程。
examples.en: The sponsor issued a project charter before detailed planning.

examples.zh: 项目章程列明了发起人和初始预算。
examples.en: The project charter names the sponsor and initial budget.

examples.zh: 放行试点模具前，我们举行了阶段关卡评审。
examples.en: We held a stage-gate review before releasing the pilot tooling.

examples.zh: 阶段关卡评审需要耐久测试的证据。
examples.en: The stage-gate review requires evidence from the durability test.

examples.zh: 团队将在安全测试后作出继续或停止的决定。
examples.en: The team will make a go-no-go decision after the safety test.

examples.zh: 继续或停止的决策取决于最终泄漏测试结果。
examples.en: The go-no-go decision depends on the final leakage results.

examples.zh: 所有未结风险都必须满足阶段退出标准或有获批计划。
examples.en: All open risks must meet the phase exit criteria or have an approved plan.

examples.zh: 开发开始前记录阶段退出标准。
examples.en: Document the phase exit criteria before development begins.

examples.zh: 两个职能部门无法达成一致时，我们请项目发起人介入。
examples.en: We engaged the project sponsor when the two functions could not agree.

examples.zh: 项目发起人为额外试验争取到了资金。
examples.en: The project sponsor secured funding for the additional trial.

examples.zh: 该项目群附带两项条件通过了治理检查点。
examples.en: The program passed the governance checkpoint with two conditions.

examples.zh: 治理检查点确认了谁有权批准进一步支出。
examples.en: The governance checkpoint confirmed who could authorize further spending.

examples.zh: 我们启动了针对过程控制的供应商发展计划。
examples.en: We launched a supplier development plan for process control.

examples.zh: 供应商发展计划包含测量技术培训。
examples.en: The supplier development plan includes training on measurement techniques.

examples.zh: 采购方在分配采购量前进行了产能审核。
examples.en: The buyer conducted a capacity audit before awarding the volume.

examples.zh: 产能审核发现了最终检验的瓶颈。
examples.en: The capacity audit found a bottleneck in final inspection.

examples.zh: 供应商在新生产线上完成了按节拍试生产。
examples.en: The supplier completed a run-at-rate on the new line.

examples.zh: 按节拍试生产暴露了补料时频繁停机的问题。
examples.en: The run-at-rate exposed frequent stops during material replenishment.

examples.zh: 出货前我们必须完成生产件批准程序。
examples.en: We must complete the production part approval process before shipment.

examples.zh: 生产件批准程序需要有代表性的量产样件。
examples.en: The production part approval process requires representative production samples.

examples.zh: 质量部门针对重复缺陷发出了供应商纠正措施请求。
examples.en: Quality issued a supplier corrective action request for the repeat defect.

examples.zh: 将缺陷照片附在供应商纠正措施请求中。
examples.en: Attach defect photographs to the supplier corrective action request.

examples.zh: 我们为前三批安排了源头检验。
examples.en: We arranged source inspection for the first three lots.

examples.zh: 源头检验在货物离厂前发现了密封件损坏。
examples.en: Source inspection detected damaged seals before the goods left.

examples.zh: 合同明确了工装所有权和存储义务。
examples.en: The contract clarifies tooling ownership and storage obligations.

examples.zh: 将模具转至另一家工厂前先解决工装所有权问题。
examples.en: Resolve tooling ownership before transferring molds to another factory.

examples.zh: 我们在最终设计评审前下单采购了长交期物项。
examples.en: We released the long-lead item before the final design review.

examples.zh: 定制电机是本次制造的长交期物项。
examples.en: The custom motor is a long-lead item for this build.

examples.zh: 计划员批准了列明每周数量的供应商交付恢复计划。
examples.en: The planner approved a supplier recovery schedule with weekly quantities.

examples.zh: 供应商交付恢复计划优先处理已逾期订单。
examples.en: The supplier recovery schedule prioritizes orders already past due.

examples.zh: 采购部门按商品类别解释了采购价格差异。
examples.en: Procurement explained the purchase price variance by commodity.

examples.zh: 汇率造成了部分采购价格差异。
examples.en: Exchange rates contributed to the purchase price variance.

examples.zh: 我们冻结了未来两周的主生产计划。
examples.en: We froze the master production schedule for the next two weeks.

examples.zh: 主生产计划反映了客户修订后的预测。
examples.en: The master production schedule reflects the revised customer forecast.

examples.zh: 系统每晚运行物料需求计划。
examples.en: The system runs material requirements planning every night.

examples.zh: 物料需求计划标出了铜端子短缺。
examples.en: Material requirements planning flagged a shortage of copper terminals.

examples.zh: 销售在确认订单前核查了可承诺数量。
examples.en: Sales checked the available-to-promise quantity before confirming the order.

examples.zh: 可承诺库存低于仓库总库存。
examples.en: The available-to-promise stock is lower than total warehouse stock.

examples.zh: 工厂对热处理生产线采用有限产能排程。
examples.en: The plant uses finite capacity scheduling for the heat-treatment line.

examples.zh: 有限产能排程考虑了烘箱的维护停机。
examples.en: Finite capacity scheduling accounts for the oven's maintenance shutdown.

examples.zh: 计划部门在确认物料后下达了生产工单。
examples.en: Planning released the production order after material confirmation.

examples.zh: 生产工单规定制造五百个蓝色外壳。
examples.en: The production order specifies five hundred blue housings.

examples.zh: 主管在每班开始时检查派工清单。
examples.en: The supervisor reviews the dispatch list at the start of each shift.

examples.zh: 派工清单将逾期维修任务排在首位。
examples.en: The dispatch list puts the overdue repair job first.

examples.zh: 排程员将紧急任务安排到一个合格的工作中心。
examples.en: The scheduler loaded the urgent job onto a qualified work center.

examples.zh: 这个工作中心可以进行钻孔和攻丝。
examples.en: This work center can handle both drilling and tapping.

examples.zh: 工程部门在工艺试验后更新了工艺路线表。
examples.en: Engineering updated the routing sheet after the process trial.

examples.zh: 工艺路线表现在包含最终装配前的清洁。
examples.en: The routing sheet now includes cleaning before final assembly.

examples.zh: 我们对照已发布图纸验证了物料清单。
examples.en: We validated the bill of materials against the released drawing.

examples.zh: 物料清单规定每套组件使用两个垫圈。
examples.en: The bill of materials lists two washers per assembly.

examples.zh: 计划员发布了下周生产的缺料报告。
examples.en: The planner issued a shortage report for next week's builds.

examples.zh: 缺料报告按订单列出短缺零件。
examples.en: The shortage report identifies missing parts for each order.

examples.zh: 质量部门在风险研讨会前审查了工艺流程图。
examples.en: Quality reviewed the process flow diagram before the risk workshop.

examples.zh: 工艺流程图显示了零件进入清洁工序的位置。
examples.en: The process flow diagram shows where parts enter cleaning.

examples.zh: 团队在试验后更新了过程失效模式与影响分析。
examples.en: The team updated the process failure mode and effects analysis after the trial.

examples.zh: 过程失效模式与影响分析涵盖错误装配。
examples.en: The process failure mode and effects analysis covers incorrect assembly.

V20261018-032.gloss: 过程失效模式与影响分析

examples.zh: 增加探测控制后，我们重新计算了风险优先数。
examples.en: We recalculated the risk priority number after adding detection controls.

examples.zh: 风险优先数帮助确定问题的评审优先顺序。
examples.en: The risk priority number helps prioritize issues for review.

examples.zh: 操作员对每个生产批次都遵循控制计划。
examples.en: Operators follow the control plan for every production lot.

examples.zh: 控制计划规定每小时检查焊接强度。
examples.en: The control plan specifies hourly checks of weld strength.

examples.zh: 图纸将扭矩标为特殊特性。
examples.en: The drawing identifies torque as a special characteristic.

examples.zh: 密封直径是这张图纸上的特殊特性。
examples.en: Seal diameter is a special characteristic on this drawing.

examples.zh: 失控点触发了反应计划。
examples.en: The out-of-control point triggered the reaction plan.

examples.zh: 反应计划要求停产并隔离零件。
examples.en: The reaction plan requires stopping production and isolating parts.

examples.zh: 厂长在夜班执行了一次分层过程审核。
examples.en: The plant manager performed a layered process audit on the night shift.

examples.zh: 分层过程审核检查操作员是否遵循换线指导。
examples.en: The layered process audit checks whether operators follow setup instructions.

examples.zh: 工程部门用三个月的数据计算了过程绩效指数。
examples.en: Engineering calculated the process performance index from three months of data.

examples.zh: 材料更换后，过程绩效指数下降了。
examples.en: The process performance index fell after the material change.

examples.zh: 该研究使用认证参考件估算了量具偏倚。
examples.en: The study estimated gauge bias with certified reference parts.

examples.zh: 量具偏倚解释了读数为何持续高于参考值。
examples.en: Gauge bias explains why readings consistently exceed the reference value.

examples.zh: 实验室在整个量程内验证了量具线性。
examples.en: The laboratory verified gauge linearity across the full range.

examples.zh: 量具线性研究使用了不同尺寸的参考块。
examples.en: The gauge linearity study used reference blocks of different sizes.

examples.zh: 我们在两小时内建立了问题遏制措施。
examples.en: We established problem containment within two hours.

examples.zh: 问题遏制措施包括装货前检查每个纸箱。
examples.en: Problem containment included checking every carton before loading.

examples.zh: 团队在包装线上实施了一项临时对策。
examples.en: The team implemented a temporary countermeasure on the packing line.

examples.zh: 第二次人工检查充当了临时对策。
examples.en: A second manual check served as a temporary countermeasure.

examples.zh: 质量部门在试验后批准了永久纠正措施。
examples.en: Quality approved the permanent corrective action after the trial.

examples.zh: 永久纠正措施是更换不可靠的定位销。
examples.en: The permanent corrective action replaces the unreliable locating pin.

examples.zh: 三十批稳定生产后，我们完成了有效性验证。
examples.en: We completed verification of effectiveness after thirty stable lots.

examples.zh: 有效性验证包括检查是否再次收到同类投诉。
examples.en: Verification of effectiveness includes checking for repeat complaints.

examples.zh: 评审加强了所有生产线的再发防止措施。
examples.en: The review strengthened recurrence prevention across all lines.

examples.zh: 再发防止要求更新其他厂区的培训。
examples.en: Recurrence prevention requires updating training at the other sites.

examples.zh: 安全工程师针对断电进行了故障树分析。
examples.en: The safety engineer built a fault tree analysis for loss of power.

examples.zh: 故障树分析识别了两种可能同时作用的故障。
examples.en: Fault tree analysis identified two failures that could combine.

examples.zh: 我们用帕累托分析聚焦两类最大的缺陷。
examples.en: We used Pareto analysis to focus on the two largest defect families.

examples.zh: 帕累托分析显示划伤占不合格面板的大多数。
examples.en: Pareto analysis showed scratches accounted for most rejected panels.

examples.zh: 团队在验证原因前绘制了因果图。
examples.en: The team drew a cause-and-effect diagram before testing causes.

examples.zh: 因果图按过程类别归纳了可能原因。
examples.en: The cause-and-effect diagram grouped possible causes by process category.

examples.zh: 我们通过是与非分析锁定了受影响的配置。
examples.en: We performed an is-is not analysis to isolate the affected configuration.

examples.zh: 是与非分析比较了受影响与未受影响的班次。
examples.en: The is-is not analysis compared affected and unaffected shifts.

examples.zh: 报告同时确定了发生原因和缺陷流出根因。
examples.en: The report identifies both the occurrence cause and the escape root cause.

examples.zh: 缺陷流出根因是检验方法灵敏度不足。
examples.en: The escape root cause was an inspection method lacking sensitivity.

examples.zh: 服务部门在一小时内登记了客户投诉。
examples.en: Service logged the customer complaint within one hour.

examples.zh: 客户投诉描述了正常运行期间的噪声。
examples.en: The customer complaint describes noise during normal operation.

examples.zh: 团队对照序列号历史记录审查了保修索赔。
examples.en: The team reviewed the warranty claim against the serial history.

examples.zh: 提交保修索赔时附上购买收据。
examples.en: Submit the purchase receipt with your warranty claim.

examples.zh: 我们为故障设备签发了退料授权。
examples.en: We issued a return material authorization for the failed unit.

examples.zh: 退料授权包含预付运费的运输标签。
examples.en: The return material authorization includes a prepaid shipping label.

examples.zh: 工程部门利用退回样品调查了现场失效。
examples.en: Engineering investigated the field failure using the returned sample.

examples.zh: 这次现场失效发生在使用数周后。
examples.en: The field failure occurred after several weeks of use.

examples.zh: 公司发布了关于连接器检查的服务通告。
examples.en: The company released a service bulletin for the connector inspection.

examples.zh: 服务通告说明了如何更换密封件。
examples.en: The service bulletin explains how to replace the seal.

examples.zh: 供应商提交了一份附有证据的纠正措施报告。
examples.en: The supplier submitted a corrective action report with evidence.

examples.zh: 纠正措施报告包含改进前后的检验结果。
examples.en: The corrective action report includes before-and-after inspection results.

examples.zh: 我们在返工批次出货前取得了客户让步许可。
examples.en: We obtained a customer concession before shipping the reworked lot.

examples.zh: 客户让步许可仅涵盖列明的序列号。
examples.en: The customer concession covers only the listed serial numbers.

examples.zh: 恢复计划改善了第二季度的交付绩效。
examples.en: The recovery plan improved delivery performance in the second quarter.

examples.zh: 承运人减少收货频率后，交付绩效恶化了。
examples.en: Delivery performance deteriorated when the carrier reduced collection frequency.

examples.zh: 仪表板按客户衡量准时足量交付情况。
examples.en: The dashboard measures on-time-in-full delivery by customer.

examples.zh: 我们在每周物流会议上审查准时足量交付结果。
examples.en: We review on-time-in-full results at the weekly logistics meeting.

examples.zh: 供应商发来了载有确认日期的订单确认书。
examples.en: The supplier sent an order acknowledgment with the confirmed date.

examples.zh: 订单确认书上的价格与我们的要求不同。
examples.en: The order acknowledgment shows a different price from our request.

examples.zh: 工厂增加了周末班次以清理欠交订单。
examples.en: The plant added a weekend shift to clear the backorder.

examples.zh: 欠交订单包含三箱替换滤芯。
examples.en: The backorder includes three cartons of replacement filters.

examples.zh: 客户接受了分批交付以保障安装。
examples.en: The customer accepted a split delivery to protect installation.

examples.zh: 分批交付让安装人员可以先用已有零件开工。
examples.en: A split delivery lets the installer start with available parts.

examples.zh: 承运人预约了周二上午到货。
examples.en: The carrier booked a delivery appointment for Tuesday morning.

examples.zh: 仓库拒绝了未预约到货的卡车。
examples.en: The warehouse rejected trucks without a delivery appointment.

examples.zh: 报关代理在提货前提交了出口申报单。
examples.en: The broker filed the export declaration before pickup.

examples.zh: 出口申报单必须与商业发票一致。
examples.en: The export declaration must match the commercial invoice.

examples.zh: 我们指定了一家熟悉医疗器械的报关代理。
examples.en: We appointed a customs broker familiar with medical devices.

examples.zh: 报关代理要求提供更清晰的产品描述。
examples.en: The customs broker requested a clearer product description.

examples.zh: 快速放行单据帮助我们避免了滞箱费。
examples.en: Fast document release helped us avoid a demurrage charge.

examples.zh: 集装箱滞留港口期间，滞箱费不断增加。
examples.en: The demurrage charge increased while the container remained at port.

examples.zh: 物流部门用闸口记录对超期用箱费提出异议。
examples.en: Logistics disputed the detention charge with gate records.

examples.zh: 空箱归还过迟产生了超期用箱费。
examples.en: Returning the empty container late caused a detention charge.

examples.zh: 仓库附上损坏照片提交了货运索赔。
examples.en: The warehouse filed a freight claim with photos of the damage.

examples.zh: 货运索赔解决前保留包装。
examples.en: Keep the packaging until the freight claim is resolved.

examples.zh: 我们为原型设备购买了货物运输保险。
examples.en: We purchased cargo insurance for the prototype equipment.

examples.zh: 检查货物运输保险是否涵盖卸货时的损坏。
examples.en: Check whether cargo insurance covers damage during unloading.

examples.zh: 货件在清关后未按时到达一个运输追踪节点。
examples.en: The shipment missed a tracking milestone after customs release.

examples.zh: 到达中转枢纽是我们的下一个运输追踪节点。
examples.en: Arrival at the transfer hub is our next tracking milestone.

examples.zh: 人力资源部门在推广前进行了培训需求分析。
examples.en: HR conducted a training needs analysis before the rollout.

examples.zh: 培训需求分析突出了故障诊断方面的差距。
examples.en: The training needs analysis highlighted gaps in fault diagnosis.

examples.zh: 主管为关键操作维护一份能力矩阵。
examples.en: The supervisor maintains a competency matrix for critical operations.

examples.zh: 能力矩阵显示了谁可以批准最终检验。
examples.en: The competency matrix shows who can approve final inspections.

examples.zh: 辅导计划弥补了换线核查方面的技能差距。
examples.en: The coaching plan closed the skill gap in setup verification.

examples.zh: 用真实样品练习帮助她弥补了技能差距。
examples.en: Practice on real samples helped close her skill gap.

examples.zh: 爬坡计划考虑了新操作员的学习曲线。
examples.en: The ramp plan accounts for the learning curve of new operators.

examples.zh: 学习曲线显示，随着反复练习，装配时间逐渐缩短。
examples.en: The learning curve shows assembly times falling with repeated practice.

examples.zh: 各厂区为新流程指定了一位变革推动者。
examples.en: Each site appointed a change champion for the new workflow.

examples.zh: 我们的变革推动者在班会上演示新表单。
examples.en: Our change champion demonstrates the new form during shift meetings.

examples.zh: 简化登录消除了一大采用障碍。
examples.en: Simpler login removed a major adoption barrier.

examples.zh: 不可靠的无线网络仍是车间采用新系统的障碍。
examples.en: Unreliable wireless access remains an adoption barrier on the floor.

examples.zh: 系统切换前，我们评估了用户准备度。
examples.en: We assessed user readiness before the system cutover.

examples.zh: 用户准备度包括能使用正常工作的手持扫描器。
examples.en: User readiness includes access to a working handheld scanner.

examples.zh: 团队利用一个周末执行了过渡计划。
examples.en: The team executed the transition plan over one weekend.

examples.zh: 过渡计划保留旧系统以应对紧急情况。
examples.en: The transition plan keeps the old system available for emergencies.

examples.zh: 经理与新任组长商定了一份辅导计划。
examples.en: The manager agreed on a coaching plan with the new team lead.

examples.zh: 她的辅导计划包括观摩两位资深主管。
examples.en: Her coaching plan includes observing two experienced supervisors.

examples.zh: 我们通过跟岗学习和每周沟通管理角色交接。
examples.en: We managed the role transition with shadowing and weekly check-ins.

examples.zh: 角色交接将排程职责移交给计划团队。
examples.en: The role transition transferred scheduling duties to the planning team.

examples.zh: 该项目群为供应商主数据指定了数据负责人。
examples.en: The program assigned a data owner for supplier master records.

examples.zh: 数据负责人批准对客户定义的更改。
examples.en: The data owner approves changes to the customer definition.

examples.zh: 财务为成本中心数据指定了一位数据管理员。
examples.en: Finance named a data steward for cost-center data.

examples.zh: 数据管理员每天早上调查重复的供应商代码。
examples.en: The data steward investigates duplicate supplier codes each morning.

examples.zh: 团队在迁移订单前清理了主数据。
examples.en: The team cleaned master data before migrating orders.

examples.zh: 错误的主数据导致订单使用了旧地址。
examples.en: Incorrect master data caused orders to use obsolete addresses.

examples.zh: 一个团队负责管理所有工厂的参考数据。
examples.en: One team governs reference data for all plants.

examples.zh: 国家代码作为共享参考数据维护。
examples.en: Country codes are maintained as shared reference data.

examples.zh: 分析员记录了从源头到仪表板的数据血缘。
examples.en: The analyst documented data lineage from source to dashboard.

examples.zh: 数据血缘帮助我们将总额追溯到发票。
examples.en: Data lineage helps us trace a total back to invoices.

examples.zh: 法务为检验记录制定了数据保留规则。
examples.en: Legal defined data retention rules for inspection records.

examples.zh: 数据保留政策规定了何时删除归档日志。
examples.en: The data retention policy specifies when archived logs are deleted.

examples.zh: 基于角色的权限加强了访问控制。
examples.en: Role-based permissions strengthened access control.

examples.zh: 访问控制防止受训人员更改已批准规格。
examples.en: Access control prevents trainees from changing approved specifications.

examples.zh: 财务对总账与报告进行了数据对账。
examples.en: Finance performed data reconciliation between the ledger and the report.

examples.zh: 数据对账发现月度汇总缺少收货记录。
examples.en: Data reconciliation revealed missing receipts in the monthly summary.

examples.zh: 政策将ERP规定为库存的权威记录系统。
examples.en: The policy defines the ERP as the system of record for inventory.

examples.zh: 使用权威记录系统核实当前余额。
examples.en: Use the system of record to verify the current balance.

examples.zh: 该表单对承诺日期应用了一项数据验证规则。
examples.en: The form applies a data validation rule to the promised date.

examples.zh: 数据验证规则阻止输入负数订单量。
examples.en: A data validation rule blocks negative order quantities.

examples.zh: 供应商为模具费设定了很高的锚定点。
examples.en: The supplier set a high anchor point for the tooling fee.

examples.zh: 他们的首次报价成为后续报价的锚定点。
examples.en: Their opening quote became the anchor point for later offers.

examples.zh: 我们在会议前估算了议价区间。
examples.en: We estimated the bargaining range before the meeting.

examples.zh: 双方修改底线后，议价区间缩小了。
examples.en: The bargaining range narrowed after both sides revised their limits.

examples.zh: 谈判代表守住了保留价格，避免了不划算的交易。
examples.en: The negotiator protected the reservation price and avoided an uneconomic deal.

examples.zh: 我们的保留价格考虑了更换供应商的成本。
examples.en: Our reservation price includes the cost of switching suppliers.

examples.zh: 我们准备了与采购量和付款条件挂钩的让步策略。
examples.en: We prepared a concession strategy linked to volume and payment terms.

examples.zh: 让步策略以更长合同期换取更低单价。
examples.en: The concession strategy exchanges longer contracts for lower unit prices.

examples.zh: 我们提出在交期与订单稳定性之间进行价值交换。
examples.en: We proposed a value trade between lead time and order stability.

examples.zh: 价值交换让我们获得更快服务，让对方获得可预测需求。
examples.en: A value trade gave us faster service and them predictable demand.

examples.zh: 供应商提出了涵盖价格、保修和培训的一揽子协议。
examples.en: The vendor offered a package deal covering price, warranty, and training.

examples.zh: 一揽子协议包含安装和两次维护上门服务。
examples.en: The package deal includes installation and two maintenance visits.

examples.zh: 管理层在最终谈判前确定了退出底线。
examples.en: Management defined a walk-away point before final negotiation.

examples.zh: 退出底线避免我们接受无限责任。
examples.en: The walk-away point protects us from accepting unlimited liability.

examples.zh: 团队与总监确认了谈判授权范围。
examples.en: The team confirmed the negotiation mandate with the director.

examples.zh: 我的谈判授权范围不包含知识产权变更。
examples.en: My negotiation mandate excludes changes to intellectual property rights.

examples.zh: 我们通过议题联动，以更快付款换取较低价格。
examples.en: We used issue linkage to exchange faster payment for lower price.

examples.zh: 议题联动将保修范围与维护合同联系起来。
examples.en: Issue linkage connected warranty coverage with the maintenance contract.

examples.zh: 双方团队采用原则式谈判，将人与问题分开。
examples.en: The teams used principled negotiation to separate people from the problem.

examples.zh: 原则式谈判帮助双方团队聚焦可衡量的服务需求。
examples.en: Principled negotiation helped both teams focus on measurable service needs.

examples.zh: 市场突然将该国称为该地区的经济病夫。
examples.en: Markets abruptly labeled the country the economic sick man of the region.

examples.zh: 这篇文章质疑经济病夫这一标签。
examples.en: The essay challenges the label of economic sick man.

examples.zh: 风险感知的加剧推高了融资成本。
examples.en: Heightened perceptions of risk raised financing costs.

examples.zh: 对危险更强烈的感知改变了投资者行为。
examples.en: A heightened perception of danger changed investors' behavior.

examples.zh: 该情景考虑政府是否可能发生国家债务违约。
examples.en: The scenario considers whether a government could default on national debt.

examples.zh: 该模型假定这个国家不会发生国家债务违约。
examples.en: The model assumes the country will not default on national debt.

examples.zh: 随着担忧加剧，投资者购买了违约保险。
examples.en: Investors bought insurance against default as concern increased.

examples.zh: 感知风险上升时，违约保险会变贵。
examples.en: Insurance against default becomes costly when perceived risk rises.

examples.zh: 公告发布后，示威席卷了这座城市。
examples.en: The city was swept by demonstrations after the announcement.

examples.zh: 相互矛盾的公告可能使恐慌席卷市场。
examples.en: The market could be swept by panic after contradictory announcements.

examples.zh: 反对党候选人继续在民调中领先。
examples.en: The opposition candidate continued to lead in the polls.

examples.zh: 候选人可能在民调中领先却仍然败选。
examples.en: A candidate can lead in the polls and still lose.

examples.zh: 评审应避免意识形态驱动的推理。
examples.en: The review should avoid ideologically motivated reasoning.

examples.zh: 意识形态驱动的推理可能扭曲读者对证据的解读。
examples.en: Ideologically motivated reasoning can distort how readers interpret evidence.

examples.zh: 这篇评论表现出对该机构的明显敌意。
examples.en: The commentary showed clear animus toward the institution.

examples.zh: 他对委员会的敌意削弱了原本严谨的论证。
examples.en: His animus toward the committee weakened an otherwise careful argument.

examples.zh: 宣传活动用无数据支持的说法对读者狂轰滥炸。
examples.en: The campaign bombarded readers with claims unsupported by data.

examples.zh: 广告向观众密集灌输轻松减重的说法。
examples.en: Advertisements bombard viewers with claims about effortless weight loss.

examples.zh: 分析员质疑较小的供应商是否会成为下一个倒下的多米诺骨牌。
examples.en: Analysts asked whether the smaller supplier would be the next domino to fall.

examples.zh: 投资者担心这家银行会成为下一个倒下的多米诺骨牌。
examples.en: Investors feared the bank was the next domino to fall.

V20261018-110.gloss: 下一个倒下的多米诺骨牌

examples.zh: 快速回应限制了这次失败带来的政治余波。
examples.en: The rapid response limited the political fallout from the failure.

examples.zh: 召回的负面余波包括经销商取消订单。
examples.en: The fallout from the recall included canceled distributor orders.

examples.zh: 该提案触犯了保守派关于公共支出的价值观。
examples.en: The proposal offended conservative sensibilities about public spending.

examples.zh: 这篇社论呼应了保守派对于政府债务的价值观。
examples.en: The editorial appealed to conservative sensibilities about government debt.

examples.zh: 领导者不应为避免批评而淡化严重问题。
examples.en: Leaders should not underplay a serious problem to avoid criticism.

examples.zh: 摘要不得淡化涉及患者安全的问题。
examples.en: The summary must not underplay a problem with patient safety.

examples.zh: 预测显示该计划仍处于财政不可持续的路径上。
examples.en: The projection shows the program remains on a fiscally unsustainable path.

examples.zh: 收入下降可能使该市走上财政不可持续的路径。
examples.en: Falling revenue could put the city on a fiscally unsustainable path.

examples.zh: 政府继续维持巨额预算赤字。
examples.en: The government continued to run a large budget deficit.

examples.zh: 该预测预计政府将出现预算赤字。
examples.en: The forecast expects the government to run a budget deficit.

examples.zh: 这家工厂在同业中以交付可靠性脱颖而出。
examples.en: The plant stands out among peers for delivery reliability.

examples.zh: 她的提案以清晰的成本估算在提交方案中脱颖而出。
examples.en: Her proposal stands out among entries for its clear cost estimates.

examples.zh: 接受订单前，我们需要现实地看待产能。
examples.en: We need to get realistic about capacity before accepting the order.

examples.zh: 我们必须现实地看待能完成多少项评审。
examples.en: We must get realistic about how many reviews we can finish.

examples.zh: 改革将逐步提高法定年龄。
examples.en: The reform would gradually raise the statutory age.

examples.zh: 该提案改变了领取这项福利的法定年龄。
examples.en: The proposal changes the statutory age for receiving this benefit.

examples.zh: 团队有望按进度于五月完成资格验证。
examples.en: The team is on track to finish qualification in May.

examples.zh: 我们有望按进度在周五前清完积压订单。
examples.en: We are on track to clear the backlog by Friday.

examples.zh: 不要以牺牲质量为代价提高速度。
examples.en: Do not improve speed at the expense of quality.

examples.zh: 这些节省是以牺牲可靠的客户支持为代价的。
examples.en: The savings came at the expense of reliable customer support.

examples.zh: 反复的例外可能是治理薄弱的征兆。
examples.en: Repeated exceptions may be symptomatic of weak governance.

examples.zh: 签名缺失可能是放行程序仓促的征兆。
examples.en: Missing signatures may be symptomatic of rushed release procedures.

examples.zh: 一次未经解释的数据修订引发了信心丧失。
examples.en: An unexplained data revision triggered a loss of confidence.

examples.zh: 退款延迟导致客户信心丧失。
examples.en: Delayed refunds caused a loss of confidence among customers.

examples.zh: 拍卖失败引发了对违约的恐惧。
examples.en: The failed auction raised the specter of default.

examples.zh: 反复停电引发了对长期停产的恐惧。
examples.en: Repeated outages raise the specter of a prolonged production shutdown.

examples.zh: 紧急融资帮助打破了恶性循环。
examples.en: Emergency financing helped break the vicious circle.

examples.zh: 打折和利润率下降使店铺陷入恶性循环。
examples.en: Discounting and falling margins trapped the store in a vicious circle.

examples.zh: 该机构已经从大到不能倒发展成大到无力救助。
examples.en: The institution had grown from too big to fail to too big to save.

examples.zh: 该情景探讨合并后的银行是否大到无力救助。
examples.en: The scenario asks whether the merged bank is too big to save.
